ios.desc:
You never finished that photo book. Neither did we.

So we made PYM the other way round. Add photos as they happen, and the book is already made. No blank pages waiting for a free weekend. No evening lost scrolling through 4,000 photos. During, not after.

The book of your year. The book of your trip. The book of your baby's first year. The book of your wedding.

WHY IT IS DIFFERENT
Every other photo book starts after the moment is over: a camera roll full of duplicates, hundreds of choices and a weekend you never find. PYM starts while it is happening. Each photo you add already has its place, so there is no project waiting for you at the end. Just your book, ready when you are.

THE BOOK OF YOUR YEAR
Take one real photo a day. No filter needed, no caption required, just the moment that mattered. By the end of the year, your yearbook is already there, page by page, ready to hold in your hands. Missed a few days? Pick them from your camera roll later. On This Day brings back what you saw a year ago, and a short recap every Monday shows you the week you just lived.

THE BOOK OF YOUR TRIP
PYM notices when you have been away and offers to turn those photos into a travel book. Pick the shots you want, and a map of where you went is added from your photo locations. Traveling with friends? Everyone adds their photos to one shared album, so the book holds the trip as all of you saw it.

THE BOOK OF YOUR BABY'S FIRST YEAR
The first smile, the first bath, the first steps. You will not know which moments matter until they have happened, so PYM keeps them as they come. Photos are matched to more than 100 first-year milestones, and the baby book takes shape while you are busy living it. Grandparents can follow along and add their own photos too.

THE BOOK OF YOUR WEDDING
Your guests took hundreds of photos. Most never reach you. With PYM, guests scan a QR code at the table and add their photos straight from their browser, no app needed. Every photo lands in one private album, sorted into chapters like Getting Ready, Ceremony and Party. When you are ready, order the wedding book.

FOR THE PEOPLE WHO LIVED IT
Share moments with your InnerCircle, the handful of people who matter most. Invite family to a shared album, or friends to a trip. Every book can hold everyone's photos, not just your own.

EVEN IF YOU NEVER PRINT A PAGE
PYM is still the best place for a private daily journal. No feed, no followers, no ads. Nobody to perform for, nothing to keep up with. Your photo
